site.description: Kdufoot brings together two essential tools for football coaches: AI-powered video analysis and friendly match searching between clubs.

homePage.description: AI Video Analysis & friendly matches between clubs — two tools, one platform.

about.title: 👋 About
about.intro: <0>Yanni</0>, cybersecurity student, <1>Networks & Telecommunications in Béthune</1> — I created Kdufoot to help football coaches <2>save time</2>.
about.features:
🎬 <0>AI Video Analysis — Paste a link, get ready-to-use drills.
⚽ <1>Friendly Matches & Tournaments — Find an opponent near you in a few clicks.

video.title: 🎬 AI Video Analysis
video.description: Paste a video link and our AI generates detailed exercises with synopsis, themes, and age category.

match.title: ⚽ Friendly Matches
match.description: Publish or search for friendly matches. Filter by category, level, distance, and format.

tournament.title: 🏆 Friendly Tournaments
tournament.description: Organize or participate in tournaments. Ideal for boosting your season and meeting new clubs.
